args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.head: fix/money-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change

- Updated `src/money.py` to import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Verification

- CI passed on branch `fix/money-bankers-rounding` (run `ci-0001`).

Requesting review from @alex.

2. **Fixed it on a new branch** `fix/money-bankers-rounding`: changed `src/money.py` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (the docstring already stated banker's rounding, so this aligns the implementation with the documented intent).

transcript.reasoning_content:
The test expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN):
- 2.675 → 2.68 (round half even: 2.675 is exactly halfway between 2.67 and 2.68, rounds to even → 2.68)
- 2.665 → 2.66 (round half even: 2.665 is exactly halfway between 2.66 and 2.67, rounds to even → 2.66)

The current code uses ROUND_HALF_UP. I need to change it to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.
